column3: BootUI 2.5.0 scan-timeout is exposed as SHARPIT_VULNERABILITIES_SCAN_TIMEOUT with a 60-second default and failsafe.
Jar archive naming applies to Maven archives; PyPI distributions have no archive inventory in this scan.
Maven package URL production has no PyPI counterpart in sharpit's distribution inventory.
BootUI runtime reach depends on Code Inventory and Maven dependency edges, neither of which sharpit exposes for PyPI.
BootUI symbols are populated from Maven/Code Inventory evidence; PyPI advisory symbols remain unavailable.
No MAL- or malicious-package guidance exists in sharpit; no malicious-package feature is added.
